segments.note: Canonical-path heading is represented by the then obligation; no separate condition or instruction is lost.
Do-not-broaden heading is represented by the avoid structure, retaining all three prohibitions.
Prove heading becomes the evidence structure, retaining both source proof requirements.

activation.note: Activation retains the six-segment requirement and full structural exemption set without imposing a change, finding, or GREEN-phase gate. Matching normalized names and absent URNs correctly do not fire. Parsing is honestly marked as needing a new observer; basename filtering is directly observable from paths. Full lowercase-alphanumeric normalization is retained in verifier detail.

audit.summary: All 38 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with only structural headings compressed. Exceptions, repair priorities, prohibitions, rationale and proof requirements remain intact; both shared nodes contain genuinely generic policy text.

segmentChecks.note: The canonical-path heading adds no independent obligation; its substantive instruction is preserved in then.
The do-not-broaden heading is adequately represented by the avoid structure, with all prohibitions retained.
The Prove heading is structurally compressed into evidence, and both required proofs remain.
The behavioral-acceptance proof is retained verbatim in evidence[2] and appropriately shared as generic phase-loop policy.
Strict disposition is retained in verifier_detail and the shared policy, which also preserves fail-on-every-finding, no advisory mode, and no ratchet baseline.
The core matching obligation, normalization exemption, and structural-role exception are preserved across given, then, and unless.
Lowercase-alphanumeric normalization of both sides and structural-role exemptions are explicit in verifier_detail.
The Bun-specific additions and their server-entrypoint/htmx-role rationale survive intact in verifier_detail[2].
The repair priority to correct a copied or stale header before considering a rename is explicit in prefer[1].
All thirteen exempt structural names are retained in both unless[0] and verifier_detail[2].
Case and non-alphanumeric insensitivity, including the order-row.ts/OrderRow example, are preserved.

risks: Reading only coder-facing fields, a weak coder may not know whether basename includes the extension or whether separator-insensitive means ignoring every non-alphanumeric; an explicit strip-extension/normalize-to-lowercase-alphanumerics step would remove that implementation ambiguity.

unobservable: file_kind: whether a file carries a URN and whether that URN has six segments requires a new parsing observer.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the obligation, complete exemptions, normalization, repair priorities, rationale, and proof requirements; the shared nodes and compressed headings are justified. Activation is deterministic once the declared URN-parsing observer exists, with only a minor coder-facing normalization ambiguity that does not warrant failure.
